content: Paul boatji dungan townbu Rome.

Wawu yinyamun jana Paul bubungu Italy yunganka boatji. Jana nyungun, yindu prisoner-prisoner dajin Juliusanda. Julius nyulu maja Romanandamunku soldier-soldieranka. Jana nyunguwunbu soldier-soldieranda burri dalkin Augustan-warra. Ngayu Luke, ngayu Paulunji dungan.

Nganjin boatbu walarin. Boat townmun Adramyttiummun. Boat townbu yindu-yinduymbu dunganka, bubungu Asia. Nganjin town Caesarea bawan, jalun-jalun warririn. Bama burri Aristarchus nganjinanji kadan. Nyulu townmun Thessalonicamun bubumun Macedoniamun.
Warngku yindu nganjin townbu Sidon kadarin. Maja Julius Paulunku manun-manunman. Nyulu Paul yungan jawun-karranda, jana nyungun kujinka.
Nganjin yinyamun jalun-jalun warririn baja. Muyar jirray bajaku. Yinyayinka nganjin kuwa-kuwa bajaku warririn bubungu Cyprus. Yinyaymba muyar jarra buban.
Yinyamun nganjin bubungu Cilicia, bubungu Pamphylia walkuku warririn jalun-jalun. Juma nganjin townbu Myra bubungu Lycia kadarin.
Yinyaymba majangka boat warrmba-bungan townmun Alexandriamun. Boat bubungu Italy dungan-dungan. Nganjin yinyaynji boatji dungarin.

Nganjin waymbulku dungarin warngku kulur. Juma nganjin yuba kadarin townbu Cnidus. Nganjin yarra jibarr kari dungarin baja, muyar jirray bajaku. Yinyayinka nganjin yarra naka dungarin burriraburr. Burrir burri Crete. Nganjin yuba bubungu Salmone dungarin bada burriraburr. Muyar buban yinyaymba.
Nganjin yuba bajaku warririn, jalun jaba-jaba bajaku. Nganjin bubungu kadarin, burri Fair Havens, yubaku townbu Lasea.
Nganjin ngadingka yinyaymba townbu bundarinya, bulurubu nganjinin yinyayku juru-manin. Yinyayinka Paulungku yalaman,
“Yurra bama, kaki ngana dungari baja, boat janjinji nganjinanji, yamba-yambaji. Muyar jirraykuda, jalun jaba-jabamaynkuda.”
Yamba yinya maja Paulundu kari milka-janan. Nyulu milka-janan Captainanda, dingkaranda yinduymbulu. Boat nyunguku.
Bubu Fair Havens buyun, bulur-baka bajaku. Jana bama wubulku dungarinka townbu Phoenix. Phoenix town jarra yarra kuwamundu burrira. Muyar yinyaymba buban buluruku.
Muku muyariji jalun.
Yala-yalaku muyar buban nakamun kadan. Jana jana-karrajiku balkawan, “Ngana dungarikuda.” Jana anchor kulban, burriraburr karangkaldarr warrin.
Yamba juma muku-muyariji kadan baja, jarramali burrirmun kadan baja. Yalarrku muyar kungkarrmun kadan.
Muyarabu jirraynja nganjinanga boat kanbin, kari dungan baja. Yinyamun nganjin yalaman, “Baluda, balu nganangan muyarabuku wundi.” Nganjin jurrkijin, muyarabu boat yaykarrdaku yungan.

Nganjin burrira karrkaymba, burri Cauda, yuba bajaku warririn. Muyar jarra buban yinyaymba. Nganjin dingki, lifeboat kudamundu kulbal-kulban. Nganjin dingki lifeboat boatbu yalbaymba jarra-kulbanka, kajanka. Nganjinanga lifeboat kulngkul bajaku, yamba nganjin jarra-kulban, karrabu kajan.

Dingki kajan, jana boat yalbay kajanka karrabu. Jana karra bada-bada boatmundurr kajan, dumbarrinji. Jana yinyilman, muyarabu boat jukara jirraymba buyburr-damanji bubungu Libya. Yinyayinka jana mararr kulban, bada-bungan. Muyarabu nganjinin wundinda.
Muyar jirray bajakukuda. Warngku yindu jana yamba-yamba kanbal jalunbu yilban.
Warngku yindu jana junjuy-junjuy jarra kulngkul yilban.
Nganjin wungar, dawar kari nyajin ngadingka bajaku. Muyar jirray kankadanku. Balu jalunmun kari kadarinka baja, balu nganjin wubulku bujil-janjirinkakuda.

Nganjin mayi kari nukan ngadimun bajaku, muyarka. Yinyayinka Paul dingkar-dingkaranda dungan. Nyulu yalaman, “Yurra ngaykundu milka-jananyaku burrira Crete. Ngana kari boatji warrinyaku yinyamun bubumun. Ngana bundanyaku, ngana yinyarrin yamba-yamba kari yilbanyaku.
Baluda, kari milka-bujarmaka. Boat janjilarrkukuda, yamba ngana kari bujil-janjil. Ngana wubulku juranku bundari.
Yurra binalbi ngaykuwunku majanka, nyulu God. Ngayu Godunku workmanmal, nyungun buyay-manil-manil. Wujurrbuku Godumu angel nguwimal milbijin ngaykundu.
Nyulu ngaykundu yalaman, “Kari yinyilmaka, Paul. Yundu majanda Caesaranda must dungay. Bama yununji Godungku miyil-kujil. Jana kari bujil-janjiri, kari wulari.”
Paulungku yalaman baja, “Yinyayinka yurra burrkul-dandimaka. Ngayu God kuku nyajil. Nyulu nganangan ngulkurrduku kujil yala angelangka ngaykundu yalaman.
Yamba muyarabu ngananji boat burrira wundil-wundil.”
Yala, nganjin warngku 14-bala jalunbu walngkal-walngkan jarramalinga. Jalun burri Mediterranean. Kunarangkalba bajaku jananda sailor-sailoranda milkanga kadan, jana yalaman, “Bubu yubakuda.”
Jana badur yungan, nyajinka wanjabu yalkan. Bana dajali bajaku, 40 metres. Juma jana badur yungan baja, bana jarra yalkanmalmaynda, 30 metres.
Jana yinyilmarin, boat kadabanji kulji-kuljinga. Yinyayinka jana anchor 4-bala walay-manin kudamundumun boatmun. Yinyamun jana miyil-kujil-kujin wanja-wanja mudu-wayjunyumunku.
Jana sailor-sailor boatmun ngakijinka. Jana dingki walay-manin bananga. Jana jurrilman jana anchor jakalbamun boatmun walay-maninka.
Yamba Paulungku majanda soldier-soldieranda yalaman, “Kaki jana sailor-sailor kari boatbu bundari, yurra wubulku bujil-janjirikuda.”
Yinyayinka soldier-soldierangka karra yakan, dingki daranda bananga.
Yalibalaku mudu-wayjunjiku, Paulungku jananda yalaman, “Yurra mayi nukada. Yurra 2 weekmunku bundandarin, yurra mayi kari nukan.
Yurra mayi nukangarr, junkurrjimanijinka. Yurra kari milka-bujarmaka, yurra kari bujil-janjil, bama kari wulay.”
Wawu yinyamun Paulungku mayi bread manin, miyil nandajin, God thankim-bunganka, nukanda.
Jana Paulumu kuku nyajin, jana bangkarr junkurrjimanijinkuda, jana mayi nukanya.
Ngana wubulku 276-bala boatbu.
Wawu mayi nukanyamun jana mayi wheat jalunbu yilban, boat jarra burdal-bunganka.
Boat dumbarrijin.
Wungar dakan, jana sailor-sailor bubuku binal kari. Jana jurru nyajin jukariji, kulji kari. Jana boat yinya dakay-maninka jukara.
Jana karra yakan anchormun, jana anchor banangaku bawanda. Jana yalarrku karra walngan binanmun. Yinyamun jana mararr wangkar-bunganda jakalba boatbu. Muyarabu boat yunganda.
Yamba boat jukara yikinba banaburr warrin. Dukul walan, jaybinyarrku, kari wandin baja. Boat bijikan dumbarrinkuda, mulngkubu.
Jana soldier-soldierangka prisoner-prisoner yarkinkaku kuninka. Wawu kari prisoner-prisoner marajinji bubungu, yala ngakijinji.

Yamba janawundu majangka wawu kari Paul kuninka. Yinyayinka nyulu soldier-soldier kanbin prisoner-prisoner kuninka. Nyulu yalaman, “Yurra kanbal marajinka binal, yurrangarr jakalba dungarika. Jalamaka boatmun, marajika, bubungu dungarika.
Yurra binal kari marajinka, yurra yulal karrba boatmun.” Yalaku nganjin wubulku juranku bubungu kadarin.
